name: phosphatidylinositol binding clathrin assembly protein
pathways: positive regulation of Ras protein signal transduction

function.text: PICALM encodes phosphatidylinositol-binding clathrin assembly protein. Annotated molecular activities include 1-phosphatidylinositol binding and SNARE binding. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of Ras protein signal transduction.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: PICALM–MLLT10 rearrangements have been reported in acute myeloid leukemia, acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and lymphoid malignancies.
